memo: First concrete remittance lead: 1500–09 nearly £32k paid to king, 1505–09 £4020/year average royal remittance from Calais Staple, 1505–09 £5784/year average towards garrison wages. Grummitt based on TNA E101/201/28. These are different slices of SAME account and cannot be added or called net imperial profit. Annual payroll contractual £10022 4s 8d not actual annual pay. 1504 Act chapter numbering conflict (Grummitt c27 vs Harper c22) must be resolved by Statutes of the Realm or Parliament Rolls before external publication.
publication_blockers: Primary E101/201/28 not independently viewed; numerical values secondary scholarly reconstruction
Verify statute chapter conflicting c22/c27 (likely c27, but do not assert as checked original)
Check 1505-1509 4 fiscal-year boundaries and nominal values; compare exact annual lines with total £32000
Do not mix Calais UK Crown transfers with resident commerce profits, military payroll, or French treaty pensions
Remittances ultimately draw on wool customs exported from England, not proof of profits extracted from local Calais inhabitants
